Yes, if no build with `is.waiwai.dictation` has reached anyone outside your own Macs. Pre-launch is the cheapest moment to rename.

The rule exists because the ID anchors things for existing installs:
- macOS treats `is.waiwai.openramble` as a new app, so every existing user would have to re-grant Accessibility.
- Their preferences and keychain items would not carry over.
- Sparkle may refuse to update across an ID change. I haven't verified this, so check it before relying on it.

If real users exist, I'd keep the old ID. If it's only you and a few testers, rename now and accept a one-time re-grant.

The EdDSA key is unaffected, and the rename doesn't touch the signing order. Afterwards, update the rule in the rules file and `docs/release.md` so they don't contradict the new ID.

Has the old ID shipped to anyone?
